description: The taste.lab logo: the lucide flask on a primary tile, and the name taste.lab with the dot in coral. Used as the first crumb of the header.

provenance.note: "lets try taste.lab instead of taste-lab". Flask tile over split dot, wordmark and two-tone flask.
Coral dot, picked with no reason, over plain, muted .lab and teal mono .lab.

rules: The display name is taste.lab. The CLI, package and data dir keep taste-lab (round-017 a).
Mark: the lucide flask at 62% of a primary tile with a 28% corner radius (round-017 a).
Name: one semibold weight, the dot in --chart-1 coral (round-018 b).
